_note: Rehearsed free-text requests (CLAUDE.md §10). scripts/warm_cache.py runs each once so its parse is cached (--parse-only for just these). 'demo' is the sentence typed on stage; applied to the consolidate preset it must equal consolidate_digital_first. Each request: text, apply_to (the preset it is typed on), expect (ok | unsupported) and, for some, expected: a note on what the result shows. Most requests appear twice: on baseline (cached first) and on consolidate_digital_first, the policy on screen during the demo.
